pages.english_text: It was morning on Outset Island.
pages.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot of Outset Island at dawn. Warm golden sunrise light floods across the green grass and the thatched cottages on stilts. The ocean sparkles. A few gulls drift above. The island looks completely peaceful — no humans visible yet. A quiet, safe, beautiful morning. Wind Waker cel-shaded style.

pages.english_text: Link was sleeping on the lookout.
pages.image_prompt: Top of Aryll's Lookout — a wooden watchtower platform on the eastern beach of Outset Island. Link is curled up asleep on the wooden platform, head on his arm, wearing his blue Outset Island shirt with red lobster embroidery and orange shorts. Bare feet. Sleeping peacefully under the open sky. Soft dawn light, gulls drifting above, ocean stretching out behind him.

pages.latin_text: Arulla ascendit. "Frāter! Frāter!" Lincus gemuit: "Soror mea!"
pages.english_text: Aryll climbed up. "Brother! Brother!" Link groaned: "My sister!"
pages.image_prompt: Aryll has just climbed up the wooden ladder of the watchtower and is poking her head over the platform edge, both hands on the platform, pigtails bouncing. She is grinning hugely, calling Link to wake up. Link starts awake, sitting up, eyes wide. Bright morning sky behind them, ocean below. Link still in his blue Outset shirt and orange shorts.

pages.english_text: "Today is your birthday!"
pages.image_prompt: Aryll now standing beside the bed, both arms thrown up in the air in triumph, beaming. Link sits up in bed, still rubbing one eye with a fist, beginning to smile. Hanging in the background on a beam: a simple garland of leaves and small wildflowers — Grandma and Aryll have clearly decorated the cottage while he slept. Morning light is brighter now. The joy of the day beginning. Link still in blue shirt and orange shorts.

pages.english_text: Grandma smiled. She had a gift.
pages.image_prompt: Grandma stands in the main room of the cottage by the low table, hunched and warm-faced, her white hair tied back. She holds out with both hands a neatly folded bundle of bright green cloth with a pointed green cap on top and small brown boots beside it on the table. THE HERO'S TUNIC, folded and offered. Her face is soft, nostalgic, proud. Link stands before her in his blue shirt and orange shorts, staring at the green cloth with huge eyes — amazed. Aryll peeks from behind him, hands clasped to her mouth. The gift is visually central.

pages.latin_text: Lincus vestēs viridēs induit. Hērōs erat!
pages.english_text: Link put on the green clothes. He was a hero!
pages.image_prompt: THE TRANSFORMATION PAGE. Link now stands in the middle of the cottage wearing the full green hero's tunic, green pointed cap, brown belt, brown boots — exactly the iconic outfit. Arms slightly spread, looking down at himself, a grin spreading across his face. Aryll jumps in delight beside him, pigtails flying. Grandma watches from the side, one hand over her heart. The light on Link is warm and slightly golden — he looks transformed. From this page forward, Link wears the green tunic.

pages.latin_text: Arulla in speculā exspectābat. Dōnum habēbat!
pages.english_text: Aryll was waiting at the lookout. She had a gift!
pages.image_prompt: Link, now in his green hero tunic and cap, climbs back up the ladder of the watchtower. Aryll waits at the top, holding out with both hands her treasured red telescope. Her smile is bright but a little brave — she loves this telescope, she's giving it anyway. The morning light is full now.

pages.latin_text: Lincus per perspicillum spectāvit. Mare vīdit.
pages.english_text: Link looked through the telescope. He saw the sea.
pages.image_prompt: On top of the watchtower, Link holds Aryll's red telescope up to one eye with both hands, leaning forward. Aryll stands beside him. Wind catches Link's green cap. The vast blue ocean spreads out below them, the morning sun sparkling on the waves.

pages.english_text: Look! A great bird! It was carrying a girl!
pages.image_prompt: Through-the-telescope view or split focus: the sky over the distant ocean, and in it an ENORMOUS dark bird — the Helmaroc King — wings spread, masked face, huge talons clutching a small struggling girl (Tetra, visible but small). The bird is terrifying and huge. Tiny in the foreground corner we see Link's shocked face, telescope still at his eye, mouth open in alarm. The peace has just cracked. Dark shape against bright sky.

pages.english_text: The bird dropped the girl. Into the forest!
pages.image_prompt: Mid-air action shot. The huge dark bird is banking away with empty talons, wings beating. Tetra falls through the air, arms flailing, ponytail streaming, falling toward the canopy of the island forest below. Her mouth open in a yell. The forest trees rise up to catch her. Visible in the corner: the distant cliff where tiny Link still stands watching, telescope lowered now, body tensed. Drama and motion.

pages.english_text: Link ran to Orca. "I need a sword!"
pages.image_prompt: Link bursts into Orca's house. Orca, the old swordmaster with long white hair and beard, stands holding his spear. Link points toward the forest desperately, asking for a sword. Orca's eyes narrow with understanding. Indoor scene, wooden walls.

pages.latin_text: Orca gladium dedit. Lincus in silvam cucurrit.
pages.english_text: Orca gave him a sword. Link ran into the forest.
pages.image_prompt: Orca hands Link a small sword with a solemn expression. Link accepts it with both hands, determined. Outside Orca's doorway, Link now dashes toward the forest holding the sword.

pages.english_text: Tetra lay on the ground. Bokoblins came near!
pages.image_prompt: In the forest clearing. Tetra lies unconscious on the forest floor. Two small gray Bokoblin monsters creep toward her with weapons raised. Dark tangled forest around them.

pages.english_text: Link attacked. He defeated the monsters!
pages.image_prompt: Link in his green hero tunic charges into the clearing, sword raised, attacking. Motion lines show the sword's arc. The Bokoblins are shown falling backward or vanishing in a puff as the sword swings past — NOT the moment of impact, NOT blood. Dynamic action but family-friendly.

pages.latin_text: Arulla in ponte exspectābat. Tum — umbra magna!
pages.english_text: Aryll was waiting on the bridge. Then — a great shadow!
pages.image_prompt: On the wooden suspension bridge between cliffs. Link and Tetra walk back across from the forest. On the village side, Aryll waves happily — pink dress, pigtails, big smile. Suddenly an enormous DARK SHADOW falls across the bridge. Link and Tetra look up in alarm. The huge silhouette of the Helmaroc King swoops in from above.

pages.english_text: The bird grabbed Aryll! "My sister!"
pages.image_prompt: EMOTIONAL LOW POINT. The huge dark Helmaroc King has swooped down over the bridge area and clutched Aryll in its talons. She is being lifted into the air over the chasm, pink dress flailing, sunhat flying off, arms reaching back. Mouth open in a scream. Link stands at the village end of the bridge, has dropped his sword, both arms outstretched toward her, face transformed with horror. Tetra runs onto the bridge behind Link.

pages.latin_text: Lincus cucurrit. Sed eam nōn tetigit.
pages.english_text: Link ran. But he could not reach her.
pages.image_prompt: Link sprints to the very edge of the cliff at the end of the suspension bridge, almost tumbling off. Tetra catches his arm just in time, holding him back from the drop. Link's other hand still reaches toward the sky. The bird is already a small dark shape carrying tiny pink Aryll out over the open ocean. Link's face devastated.

pages.latin_text: "Dūc mē tēcum, Tetra. Sorōrem meam servāre dēbeō."
pages.english_text: "Take me with you, Tetra. I need to rescue my sister."
pages.image_prompt: The beach now. Tetra stands on the wooden dock, half-turned, one foot already raised to step toward her pirate ship anchored offshore. Link has run after her and grabbed her sleeve with one hand — his other hand points out over the water in the direction the bird flew. His face is streaked with tears but his jaw is set — he is not just begging, he is demanding. Third and final appearance of the refrain 'Soror mea!' — now transformed from joy (p.3) through terror (p.16) to pure resolve. Tetra turns to look at him, her sharp eyes narrowing — considering.

pages.english_text: Tetra nodded. "Come aboard."
pages.image_prompt: Tetra stands on the deck of the pirate ship now, one hand on the rail, head tilted, and gives Link a single brusque nod — not warm, but not cruel. A businesslike yes. Link stands at the foot of the gangplank, small sword still in his hand, green tunic a little dirty, looking up at her. Grandma has appeared at the edge of the beach in the background — we can see her small figure with one hand pressed to her mouth, watching her grandson preparing to sail away. The wind is picking up. The ship's sails are being unfurled.

pages.english_text: The ship sailed away. Link looked back.
pages.image_prompt: FINAL IMAGE. The pirate ship under full sail on the open ocean, cutting through blue water. Outset Island is already receding in the distance — small and green behind them. Link stands at the back of the ship, both hands on the rail, looking back at the shrinking island. On the distant beach, tiny but visible: Grandma, still standing where they left her, one hand raised in a small wave. Link's face is not crying now — it is set, older somehow. Sad but going. The wind in his green cap. One boy, one sister out there somewhere, one long journey beginning. END.
